mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iam_audit_log (id, tenant_id, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, detail, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{detail}, #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO iam_audit_log (id, tenant_id, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, detail, created_at, source_service, source_event_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{detail}, #{createdAt}, #{sourceService}, #{sourceEventId})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM iam_audit_log WHERE source_service = #{sourceService} AND source_event_id = #{sourceEventId} LIMIT 1
SELECT action AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM iam_audit_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY action ORDER BY `count` DESC, action ASC LIMIT 50
SELECT resource_type AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM iam_audit_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY resource_type ORDER BY `count` DESC, resource_type ASC LIMIT 50
